title: BIRD-RL: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning over Stateful Data-Centric Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.29426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training small language models (SLMs), existing frameworks are predominantly tool-centric and struggle with data-centric environments. Specifically, applying tool-centric frameworks to stateful tasks like SQL debugging introduces severe spatial inefficiencies since proper environment isolation typically requires a separate database container per rollout. Naively reusing databases without tracking evolving states across multi-turn interactions causes trajectory contamination and cross-trajectory interference, which severely destabilizes policy updates. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce BIRD-RL, a novel four-stage agentic RL curriculum that alternately enhances foundational agent reasoning and trajectory-adaptive on-policy exploration to circumvent the instability inherently associated with direct end-to-end learning. translated_title: BIRD-RL：在有状态的数据中心环境中扩展智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 尽管智能体强化学习（RL）已成为训练小型语言模型（SLM）的一种有前景的范式，但现有框架主要面向以工具为中心的场景，难以应对以数据为中心的环境。具体而言，将工具中心型框架应用于SQL调试等有状态任务会带来严重的空间低效问题，因为合理的环境隔离通常需要为每次rollout分配一个独立的数据库容器。而在多轮交互中简单地复用数据库、不跟踪其不断演变的状态，则会导致轨迹污染和跨轨迹干扰，严重破坏策略更新的稳定性。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了BIRD-RL，一种新颖的四阶段智能体强化学习课程方法，通过交替增强基础智能体推理能力与轨迹自适应的在线策略探索，规避直接端到端学习固有的不稳定性。关键在于，为支持这一课程学习……
tldr: BIRD-RL提出了一种四阶段智能体强化学习课程方法，通过交替增强基础推理与轨迹自适应在线探索，解决了SQL调试等有状态数据中心环境中环境隔离成本高、状态污染和跨轨迹干扰导致的训练不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: BIRD-RL introduces a four-stage agentic RL curriculum that alternately enhances foundational reasoning and trajectory-adaptive on-policy exploration, overcoming state contamination, cross-trajectory interference, and spatial inefficiency in stateful data-centric environments such as SQL debugging.
